title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E19 — Boot
Station 51's mascot, Boot, won't eat; accidents befall a woman attempting to cook a meal; a man nearly dies from an aspirin overdose.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E20 — Rip-Off
The paramedics conduct several rescues under a shadow of guilt after being accused of stealing from a patient; guest Jo Anne Worley.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E21 — Audit
DeSoto must decide whether to amputate the leg of a trapped construction worker (James McEachin); nervous Gage faces an IRS tax audit.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E8 — Blood, Sweat and Cheers
B.A. drives in a stock car race to prevent Hannibal's nephew (Ken Olandt) being run off the track by thugs; guest Stuart Whitman.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E9 — Mind Games
Pardoned Face's book-promotion TV tour hits a snag when a Viet Cong general seeks revenge for his jilted daughter.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E10 — There Goes the Neighborhood
The team conceals in suburbia a rock singer threatened by terrorists, until a nosy neighbor blows the whistle.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E11 — The Doctor Is Out
The team journeys to a South American jungle to rescue Murdock's kidnapped therapist (Richard Anderson); guest Jeannetta Arnette.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E12 — Uncle Buckle-Up
The mob forces a children's TV-show host (Arte Johnson) to endorse cheap, unsafe Uncle Buckle-Up dolls.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E13 — Wheel of Fortune
Agents detour Murdock to South America when he embarks on a Hawaiian trip he won on "Wheel of Fortune"; guests Pat Sajak, Vanna White.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E14 — The A-Team Is Coming, The A-Team Is Coming
The team works with the Soviets to prevent an insane Soviet general from triggering World War III; guest William Smith.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E15 — Members Only
Face pursues a lifelong dream and cons his way into a posh country club, only to discover counterfeiters working off the seventh green.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E16 — Cowboy George
A concert deal appears shaky when Face inadvertently books Boy George & Culture Club into a rowdy cowboy nightclub.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S2 E18 — The Disciple
Banner's friend Li Sung (Mako) hands over the leadership of his group to a police officer; guests Rick Springfield, Gerald McRaney.
